meta.name: alien_invasion_farm
meta.prompt: A small farm town being invaded by aliens.

programs.brief: A metallic disc-shaped scout saucer embedded nose-down at an angle into the furrowed earth, hull plates scorched, glowing cyan circuits along the rim.
A massive biomechanical dreadnought looming low over the settlement, dark carapace plates, glowing energy conduits, and a central tractor beam housing.
An angular spiked alien insertion capsule embedded into the soil, with glowing violet fissures and alien resin spreading around its base.

tokens.terrain: rural farmland with crop fields, pastures, and dirt roads connecting scattered homesteads
tokens.event_direction: alien invaders descend from the northern sky and advance across the fields toward the town center
tokens.infra: crop_circle pressed into the corn fields; quarantine_fence along the northern fields; barricade_line across the main farm road; crash_furrow into the downed scout craft
tokens.icons: alien landing craft hovering above the fields; glowing crop glyphs; abandoned tractors and farm carts; strange bio-mounds sprouting along fence lines
